Stocky theatrical silhouette, very expressive and readable. Exact 4 columns by 4 rows, 16 entirely separate full-body cels, each centered in its equal square cell with generous transparent gutters, SAME character scale and ground baseline across frames. All face LEFT in strict side view. Row1 frames1-4: coherent walking cycle four distinct planted/passing steps with swinging coat. Row2 frames5-8: attack sequence anticipation crouch gathering straw, pitchfork raised behind head, powerful forward LEFT thrust with fully extended pitchfork, follow-through low stance.
